description: Land Acquisition - Gammaduwa, Ambanganga Korale D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations, making it primarily about land and property matters. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is only in his capacity to authorize the land acquisition under statutory powers, and the core content focuses exclusively on land acquisition details rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
